summary: benjaminion 在新的 EF Protocol 共识网站发布“升级终局性”第一期，目标是把终局时间从约 1000 秒缩短到约 10 秒。colinlyguo 把 EIP-7851 从 7702 授权标记路径改为由委托钱包代码决定，并合并。nerolation 的执行层重组状态保留窗口 EIP 合并。ethresear.ch 讨论向邮箱、手机号和社交账号进行隐私支付。当晚召开 ACDC #178。

items.topic: 账户：EIP-7851 改为由代码控制
items.title: EIP-7851：改用由代码控制的委托
items.note: （colinlyguo）提交并合并。PR 说明：一旦控制权转到委托的钱包代码，再要求原 EOA 密钥来停用残留的 ECDSA 权限，不符合“让代码决定”的模型，因为委托之后钱包可能根本不再使用旧密钥。
items.note_en: (colinlyguo), submitted and merged. The PR explains that once control has moved into delegated wallet code, requiring the original EOA key again to disable residual ECDSA authority does not fit the "let the code decide" model, since after delegation the wallet may no longer use the old key at all.

summary_en: benjaminion published Upgrading Finality, Edition 1 on the new EF Protocol consensus website, aiming to cut time to finality from about 1000 seconds to about 10. colinlyguo moved EIP-7851 away from the 7702 authorization marker path so that the delegated wallet code decides, and it was merged. nerolation's execution layer reorg state retention window EIP was merged. ethresear.ch discussed private payments to email addresses, phone numbers and social handles. ACDC #178 was held in the evening.
